name: LiquidEther-TS-TW
title: Liquid Ether
description: A fluid simulation stirs smoky purple liquid over black, folding colour into dark hollows and letting it fade again. Moving the pointer pushes a glowing splash of colour through the liquid.
use: A creative or AI page wants a living, fluid surface that answers the pointer.
avoid: A heavy simulation with a dark palette that makes overlaid small text hard to read.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with nothing to label; the constant churn ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Smoky purple liquid swirls across a near-black field, lit violet and lilac with soft blurred edges. Shapes fold into one another like ink stirred in dark water, brightest where the liquid bends.
behaves: The liquid churns without pause, curling into new folds and fading back toward black. Moving the pointer pushes a bright bloom of colour into the fluid, which then spreads out and dims.
customise: Pointer force, cursor size, viscosity, solver iterations, resolution, palette and auto-demo motion are props; the shader passes need source edits.
weight: heavy: A multi-pass fluid simulation renders every frame in WebGL.
demo: Purple liquid on black, stirred by the automatic demo pointer.
polishWhy: Fluid motion looks convincing and rich; edges blur into black and the palette stays one hue.
